tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page and slide background. Everything sits on paper.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All body text, headings, borders and rules on `paper` and `surface` (21:1 / 18:1). The brand is ink on paper first.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Quiet panel behind code, tables or a figure (talks' grey fill). Ink on it 18.9:1 / 17.4:1.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and table rules only; never text.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: captions, author lists, axis labels, on `paper` and `surface` (5.6:1+ both themes).

tokens.name: ink-dimmed
tokens.usage: Greyed-out items in a progressive slide build (talks' #cfcfcf). Deliberately fails contrast (1.6:1): never for content that must be read.

tokens.name: band
tokens.usage: Black header/footer band background (site header and footer). Inverts to white in dark.

tokens.name: on-band
tokens.usage: Text and links on `band`.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: THE canvas slot: the app workspace behind a document (around a slide, under a node graph). Objects on it are `paper` with `ink` frames. Apps only: never a page, card or panel background. Swap per app with `data-canvas` while the candidates are on trial.

tokens.name: canvas-grey
tokens.usage: Canvas candidate A, the current default: flat mid-light grey. Strongest separation; closest to classic desktop UIs.

tokens.name: canvas-neutral
tokens.usage: Canvas candidate C2: near-white, solid. Separates white objects without reading as a backdrop. Also the ground of the `grid` candidate.

tokens.name: canvas-warm
tokens.usage: Canvas candidate F2: light warm stock. Humane, paper-like.

tokens.name: canvas-dot
tokens.usage: Dot colour of candidate B (`dots`): 1px dots every `grid-dots` on `paper`.

tokens.name: canvas-grid-line
tokens.usage: Line colour of candidate C3 (`grid`): faint lines every `grid-lines` on `canvas-neutral`.

tokens.name: canvas-blueprint-line
tokens.usage: Line colour of candidate D2 (`blueprint`): faint blue lines every `grid-lines` on `paper`.

tokens.name: tag-1
tokens.usage: Tag 1, blue: chip swatches, coded segments, background highlights. The brand blue. Also `accent-blue`. Not for charts.

tokens.name: on-tag-1
tokens.usage: Text on a `tag-1` fill (background highlights).

tokens.name: tag-1-text
tokens.usage: Blue as text on `paper` (foreground highlights, syntax colours); 4.5:1+ light, 8:1+ dark.

tokens.name: tag-2
tokens.usage: Tag 2, orange: chip swatches, coded segments, background highlights. Pairs with tag-1 for any two things that must be told apart. Also `accent-orange`. Not for charts.

tokens.name: on-tag-2
tokens.usage: Text on a `tag-2` fill (background highlights).

tokens.name: tag-2-text
tokens.usage: Orange as text on `paper` (foreground highlights, syntax colours); 4.5:1+ light, 8:1+ dark.

tokens.name: tag-3
tokens.usage: Tag 3, teal: chip swatches, coded segments, background highlights. Not for charts.

tokens.name: on-tag-3
tokens.usage: Text on a `tag-3` fill (background highlights).

tokens.name: tag-3-text
tokens.usage: Teal as text on `paper` (foreground highlights, syntax colours); 4.5:1+ light, 8:1+ dark.

tokens.name: tag-4
tokens.usage: Tag 4, red: chip swatches, coded segments, background highlights. Also `accent-red`. Keep apart from tag-2 (they merge under red-green colour blindness). Not for charts.

tokens.name: on-tag-4
tokens.usage: Text on a `tag-4` fill (background highlights).

tokens.name: tag-4-text
tokens.usage: Red as text on `paper` (foreground highlights, syntax colours); 4.5:1+ light, 8:1+ dark.

tokens.name: tag-5
tokens.usage: Tag 5, yellow: chip swatches, coded segments, background highlights. The only light tag: always distinct. Prefer it as a fill; its text value is weak. Not for charts.

tokens.name: on-tag-5
tokens.usage: Text on a `tag-5` fill (background highlights).

tokens.name: tag-5-text
tokens.usage: Yellow as text on `paper` (foreground highlights, syntax colours); 4.5:1+ light, 8:1+ dark.

tokens.name: tag-6
tokens.usage: Tag 6, cyan: chip swatches, coded segments, background highlights. Keep apart from tag-1. Not for charts.

tokens.name: on-tag-6
tokens.usage: Text on a `tag-6` fill (background highlights).

tokens.name: tag-6-text
tokens.usage: Cyan as text on `paper` (foreground highlights, syntax colours); 4.5:1+ light, 8:1+ dark.

tokens.name: tag-7
tokens.usage: Tag 7, pink: chip swatches, coded segments, background highlights. Keep apart from tag-4. Not for charts.

tokens.name: on-tag-7
tokens.usage: Text on a `tag-7` fill (background highlights).

tokens.name: tag-7-text
tokens.usage: Pink as text on `paper` (foreground highlights, syntax colours); 4.5:1+ light, 8:1+ dark.

tokens.name: tag-8
tokens.usage: Tag 8, graphite: chip swatches, coded segments, background highlights. Neutral: 'uncoded', 'other', disabled categories. Not for charts.

tokens.name: on-tag-8
tokens.usage: Text on a `tag-8` fill (background highlights).

tokens.name: tag-8-text
tokens.usage: Graphite as text on `paper` (foreground highlights, syntax colours); 4.5:1+ light, 8:1+ dark.

tokens.name: marker-yellow
tokens.usage: Marker code scheme: background behind string literals; also a quiet 'look here' wash in code. Ink on it 18.6:1 / 8.9:1.

tokens.name: marker-cyan
tokens.usage: Marker code scheme: background behind numbers and constants. Ink on it 18.2:1 / 10.4:1.

tokens.name: accent-blue
tokens.usage: Blue accent fill (default accent). White on it 8.6:1 / 4.7:1.

tokens.name: on-accent-blue
tokens.usage: Text on `accent-blue`.

tokens.name: accent-blue-text
tokens.usage: Blue as a link or emphasis on `paper`.

tokens.name: accent-blue-tint
tokens.usage: Blue selection wash and callout panel (FreeForm talk's pale blue). Ink on it 18.2:1 / 18.5:1.

tokens.name: accent-red
tokens.usage: Red accent fill. White on it 5.1:1; the dark fill takes black (4.7:1). In a red-accented scope, errors must still carry an icon and words.

tokens.name: on-accent-red
tokens.usage: Text on `accent-red`.

tokens.name: accent-red-text
tokens.usage: Red as a link or emphasis on `paper`.

tokens.name: accent-red-tint
tokens.usage: Red selection wash. Ink on it 18.1:1 / 16.3:1.

tokens.name: accent-orange
tokens.usage: Orange accent fill. Never white on it (2.3:1); black 9:1.

tokens.name: on-accent-orange
tokens.usage: Text on `accent-orange`.

tokens.name: accent-orange-text
tokens.usage: Orange as a link or emphasis on `paper` (darker than the fill).

tokens.name: accent-orange-tint
tokens.usage: Orange selection wash. Ink on it 18.8:1 / 15.0:1.

tokens.name: accent-purple
tokens.usage: Purple accent fill (GREMLIN talk). Accent only, not a tag. White on it 6.3:1; the dark fill takes black (5.6:1). Under review.

tokens.name: on-accent-purple
tokens.usage: Text on `accent-purple`.

tokens.name: accent-purple-text
tokens.usage: Purple as a link or emphasis on `paper` (6.3:1 / 9.8:1).

tokens.name: accent-purple-tint
tokens.usage: Purple selection wash. Ink on it 17.4:1 / 17.2:1.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: THE accent slot. Components read this, never a named hue. Swap per scope with `data-accent="red|orange|purple"`.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on `accent`; follows the swap.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Links and emphasis text on `paper`; follows the swap.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Selection wash; follows the swap. Behind ink text only.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus ring. Uses the text variant so it holds 3:1+ on paper under any accent.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors only: invalid fields, failing nodes, destructive actions. As text on paper 5.6:1 / 7.4:1. Always paired with an icon and a sentence.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on `danger`.

styles.name: display

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Page and post titles.

styles.name: h2

styles.name: h3

styles.name: body

styles.usage: All running text (the site's 1rem / 1.5rem).

styles.name: small

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Tags and table headers, uppercase. The only uppercase style.

styles.name: slide-title

styles.name: slide-heading
styles.usage: Second-level slide heading.

styles.name: slide-subhead
styles.usage: Diagram labels and key claims.

styles.name: slide-label
styles.usage: Emphasised body, citations, footer name.

styles.name: slide-body
styles.sample: Don't know the function, but know how to evaluate it
styles.usage: Slide body text (talk master: 36, line height 1.32).

styles.name: slide-caption
styles.usage: Axis labels and captions on slides; smallest text in a talk.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Inline and block code on the web, on `surface`.

styles.name: code-slide
styles.usage: Code and LaTeX on slides.

styles.name: ui-title
styles.usage: Dialog titles, app name, empty-state headings.

styles.name: ui
styles.usage: Default app text: menu items, list rows, field values (desktop).

styles.name: ui-strong
styles.usage: Selected items, node titles, button labels.

styles.name: ui-label
styles.usage: Panel and section titles, uppercase. On `band` bars and above field groups.

styles.name: ui-mono
styles.usage: Numbers in fields, timecodes, live values, shortcuts.

styles.name: ui-touch
styles.usage: All text and inputs at touch density (16px stops iOS zoom on focus).

styles.name: alt-h1
styles.usage: Not adopted. Kept so Plex can be compared against Lato before the type is locked.

styles.name: alt-body
styles.sample: I build tools that help programmers debug code.
styles.usage: Not adopted; comparison only.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps; highlight vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between paragraphs and list items; highlight side padding (site .4–.5rem).

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card and button padding; page gutter on mobile (site 1rem).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked cards and sections (site 1.5rem).

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Band vertical padding; page top/bottom padding (site 2rem).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Slide margin at 1920×1080.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Every box: cards, buttons, inputs, images, highlights. The brand is square.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Only true circles: plot points, diagram nodes, status dots. Never on a box with text.

shadow.note: Never blurred. Accent offsets are brand moments (cards, primary buttons, the selected object on a canvas); ink offsets mean 'floating' in apps.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: App menus, popovers, tooltips, dragged items: anything above the page.

tokens.name: shadow-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialogs and sheets.

tokens.name: shadow-offset
tokens.usage: Clickable cards at rest (site post cards). Collapses to none on hover. Components rebuild it from `offset-lg` + `accent` so it follows an accent swap.

tokens.name: shadow-offset-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons and small chips at rest.

tokens.name: border-hair
tokens.usage: Table rules and dividers, in `rule`.

tokens.name: border-rule
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, focus ring.

tokens.name: border-heavy
tokens.usage: Cards and figure frames, in `ink` (site post cards, talk diagrams).

tokens.name: offset-lg
tokens.usage: Distance of `shadow-offset`.

tokens.name: offset-sm
tokens.usage: Distance of `shadow-offset-sm`.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Dense controls: inline icon buttons in list rows, ports, chip height.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default desktop control height: fields, buttons, tool buttons.

tokens.name: control-touch
tokens.usage: Every tappable control at touch density.

tokens.name: bar-h
tokens.usage: App top bar and toolbar height (desktop); 56px at touch density.

tokens.name: panel-w
tokens.usage: Side panel width: inspector, layers, codebook.

tokens.name: grid-dots
tokens.usage: Dot pitch of the `dots` canvas.

tokens.name: grid-lines
tokens.usage: Line pitch of the `grid` and `blueprint` canvases.

tokens.name: content-width
tokens.usage: Max width of the single text column on sites (site: 800px + 2rem).
